events.title: Council of Nicaea opens under Constantine
events.description: Bishops from across the empire gathered at Nicaea in the first ecumenical council of the Church. It condemned Arianism and produced the first version of the Nicene Creed.
events.html: Bishops from across the empire gathered at Nicaea in the first ecumenical council of the Church. It condemned Arianism and produced the first version of the Nicene Creed.

events.title: Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut in India
events.description: Da Gama's fleet arrived on India's Malabar coast after sailing around Africa. The sea route he opened allowed Portugal to bypass the overland spice trade and build an Asian empire.
events.html: Da Gama's fleet arrived on India's Malabar coast after sailing around Africa. The sea route he opened allowed Portugal to bypass the overland spice trade and build an Asian empire.

events.title: Ortelius publishes the first modern atlas
events.description: Abraham Ortelius issued the Theatrum Orbis Terrarum in Antwerp, a bound collection of uniform maps covering the known world. It became a bestseller and went through many editions.
events.html: Abraham Ortelius issued the Theatrum Orbis Terrarum in Antwerp, a bound collection of uniform maps covering the known world. It became a bestseller and went through many editions.

events.title: Napoleon restores slavery in French colonies
events.description: A law of the Consulate maintained slavery where it had not been abolished and paved the way for its return elsewhere, reversing the Revolution's abolition of 1794. Resistance helped drive Haiti to independence.
events.html: A law of the Consulate maintained slavery where it had not been abolished and paved the way for its return elsewhere, reversing the Revolution's abolition of 1794. Resistance helped drive Haiti to independence.

events.title: Levi Strauss and Jacob Davis patent riveted denim trousers
events.description: The patent for copper rivets at the stress points of work trousers marked the birth of blue jeans. Made for labourers in the American West, they became a global garment.
events.html: The patent for copper rivets at the stress points of work trousers marked the birth of blue jeans. Made for labourers in the American West, they became a global garment.

events.title: Charles Lindbergh takes off for Paris
events.description: Lindbergh left Roosevelt Field, New York, in the Spirit of St Louis. He landed at Le Bourget 33.5 hours later, completing the first solo non-stop transatlantic flight.
events.html: Lindbergh left Roosevelt Field, New York, in the Spirit of St Louis. He landed at Le Bourget 33.5 hours later, completing the first solo non-stop transatlantic flight.

events.title: Amelia Earhart sets off on her solo Atlantic flight
events.description: Earhart took off from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, and landed in a field near Derry the next day. She became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic.
events.html: Earhart took off from Harbour Grace, Newfoundland, and landed in a field near Derry the next day. She became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic.

events.title: First prisoners are brought to Auschwitz
events.description: Thirty German criminal prisoners arrived from Sachsenhausen to act as camp functionaries. Auschwitz grew into the largest Nazi death camp, where about 1.1 million people, most of them Jews, were murdered.
events.html: Thirty German criminal prisoners arrived from Sachsenhausen to act as camp functionaries. Auschwitz grew into the largest Nazi death camp, where about 1.1 million people, most of them Jews, were murdered.
